day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Josaphat, uBhishophu kunye noMartire
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, siwela phantsi kwenceba yakho. Kristu, sikhokele elukhanyeni lwakho. Nkosi, siphilise entliziyweni yakho.
psalm_response: Unoyolo lowo uncedo lwakhe lunguThixo kaYakobi.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu ethatha into enzima, mhlawumbi umthwalo, aze awubeke ecaleni ukuze amkelelwe umhlobo. KwiNcwadi kaPawulos eya kuFilemon namhlanje, sifunda ngesicelo esinzulu: 'Ndiyakucela ngenxa yomntwana wam uOnesimus... ndimthumela, okuthetha ukuthi, intliziyo yam, ndiyibuyisela kuwe.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi nje ngomkhonzi obuyayo; uthetha ngomntu owayejongwa njengongenamsebenzi, kodwa oye waba yinxalenye yentliziyo yakhe. Lo nguThixo wethu. UThixo akajongi ukuba siluncedo kangakanani na ngokwemithetho yeli hlabathi; ujonge intliziyo yethu, ujonge indlela esithandana ngayo.

UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le ndlela yokujonga ubomi. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukuthetha ngale nkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines'. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, ehlala ecwangcisa, ecinga ngendlela i-AI okanye i-cloud infrastructure inokusebenza ngayo. Kodwa ngalo lonke ixesha wayethetha ngale 'con chim airlines', wayengayenzi loo nto ngenxa yokuba efuna imali okanye udumo; wayeyenza ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda indlela izinto ezibhabha ngayo, indlela ezikhululekileyo ngayo. Xa wayegigitheka emva kokuba ethethe ngale nkampani yakhe, wayebonisa ukuba ubomi abukho kwizinto ezinkulu esizenzayo, kodwa kukuba nentliziyo ekhululekileyo, intliziyo ehlala imomotheka phambi kobuso bukaThixo.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela into engaqhelekanga: 'Umbuso kaThixo awubonakali... kuba nanko, ubuKumkani bukaThixo buphakathi kwenu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Abantu babefuna ukwazi ukuba ubuKumkani buza nini, ubuza phi, kodwa uYesu wathi: 'Buphakathi kwenu.' UbuKumkani bukaThixo abukho kwizinto ezinkulu okanye kwizikhundla; buseentliziyweni zethu xa sithandana. UBen wayeyiphila le nto. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena. Oku kukunika okungenamkhawulo, oku kuthando olungaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi. UBen wayengumntwana owayephila njengombuso kaThixo ophilayo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, kwaye ndizidibanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndohlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Nkosi, busisa aba bantwana bakho, ubaphe uxolo olungapheliyo, uze ubagcine bethandana ngonaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lweNkosi ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wokudabuka, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Sithandwa: Ndifumene uvuyo olukhulu nenkuthazo eluthandweni lwakho, kuba iintliziyo zabangcwele ziye zahlaziywa nguwe, mzalwana. Ngoko ke, nangona ndinelungelo elipheleleyo kuKristu lokukuyalela ukuba wenze okufanelekileyo, ndikucela ngothando, njengoko ndinjalo, uPawulos, indoda endala, kwaye ngoku ndilibanjwa likaKristu Yesu. Ndikucela ngenxa yomntwana wam uOnesimus, endibe nguyise kuye ekubanjweni kwam, owayengaseluncedo kuwe kodwa ngoku uluncedo kuwe nakum. Ndiyakuthumela, oko kukuthi, intliziyo yam, ndiyibuyisela kuwe. Bendithanda ukumgcina am, ukuze andikhonze endaweni yakho ekubanjweni kwam ngenxa yeVangeli, kodwa bendifuna ukungenzi nto ngaphandle kwemvume yakho, ukuze okulungileyo okwenzayo kungabi ngenkani kodwa kube ngokuzithandela. Mhlawumbi esi sesona sizathu sokuba emke kuwe okwethutyana, ukuze umbuyisele ngonaphakade, kungasengumkhonzi kodwa ngaphezu komkhonzi, umzalwana, othandekayo ngokukhethekileyo kum, kodwa ngakumbi kuwe, njengomntu naseNkosini. Ngoko ke ukuba undithatha njengomlingane, mamkele njengokuba unokundamkela mna. Kwaye ukuba ukwenze naluphi na ubugwenxa okanye ukutyala nantoni na, kubale kum. Mna, Pawulos, ndibhala ngesandla sam: Ndiya kuhlawula. Andifuni ukukuxelela ukuba undityala ubomi bakho. Ewe, mzalwana, mandizuze kuwe eNkosini. Hlaziyani intliziyo yam kuKristu.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Unoyolo lowo uncedo lwakhe lunguThixo kaYakobi. INkosi ikhusela ubulungisa babacinezelekileyo, inika ukutya kwabalambileyo. INkosi ikhulula amabanjwa. R. Unoyolo lowo uncedo lwakhe lunguThixo kaYakobi. INkosi inika ukubona kwiimfama. INkosi iphakamisa abo bagobekileyo; iNkosi iyabathanda abalungileyo. INkosi ikhusela abaphambukeli. R. Unoyolo lowo uncedo lwakhe lunguThixo kaYakobi. Inkedama nomhlolokazi iyabaxhasa, kodwa indlela yongendawo iyayithintela. INkosi iya kulawula ngonaphakade; uThixo wakho, O Ziyon, kuzo zonke izizukulwana. Alleluia. R. Unoyolo lowo uncedo lwakhe lunguThixo kaYakobi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ebuziwe ngabaFarisi ukuba ubuKumkani bukaThixo buza nini, uYesu waphendula wathi, 'Ukuza kobuKumkani bukaThixo akunakubonwa, kwaye akukho bani uya kumemezela, "Nanko, bulapha," okanye, "Bulaphaya." Kuba nanko, ubuKumkani bukaThixo buphakathi kwenu.' Wathi kubafundi bakhe, 'Iya kufika imihla apho niya kunqwenela ukubona imihla yoNyana woMntu, kodwa aniyi kuyibona. Kuya kubakho abo baya kuthi kuni, "Nanko, ulaphaya," okanye "Nanko, ulapha." Musani ukuya phaya, musani ukubaleka niphuthuma. Kuba kanye njengombane oqhwanyazayo uze ukhanyise isibhakabhaka ukusuka kwelinye icala ukuya kwelinye, uya kuba njalo uNyana woMntu ngemini yakhe. Kodwa kuqala ufanele ukubandezeleka kakhulu aze alahlwe sesi sizukulwana.'

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
